Board of Advisors

Board of AdvisorsExecutive BoardConsultant Development ProgramProject TeamsAlumni

Anna (McGraw) Miller

Director of Corporate Strategy, NFL

Anna is a 2015 graduate of UNC Kenan-Flagler, and current Director of Corporate Strategy at the National Football League (NFL). Before the NFL, Anna has spent time working at Target, the WWE, and Warner Brothers.

Tony Mayhoff

Vice President of Corporate Partnerships, Baltimore Orioles

Tony is an MBA graduate of UNC's Kenan-Flagler Business School, and has spent years in various media and marketing roles. After spending multiple years with Junior Motorsports, where he climbed the ladder to be CCO and Senior Vice President, Tony has now moved into baseball to work with the Orioles.

Ryan Meyer

Senior Director Of Ticketing, PGA TOUR Events

Ryan is a graduate of UNC with both undergraduate and graduate degrees, and is currently the Senior Director of Ticketing PGA Tour Events at the PGA Tour. Before the PGA Tour, Ryan had worked with numerous organizations in the ticketing department including UNC Athletics, International Speedway Corporation, and Stubhub.

Rick Hart

Senior Advisor, Altius Sports Partners

Rick is a 1994 graduate from UNC and currently a Senior Advisor for Altius Sports Partners. Rick spent multiple years at UNC, Oklahoma University, and UT Chattanooga before spending 13 years as the Athletic Director of SMU.

Laura Fellwock

Director, Tournament Services, HNS Sports Group

Laura is a 2016 graduate of UNC and the current Director of Tournament Services at HNS Sports Group. Before HNS Sports Group Laura has spent time in the golf space at AJGA, the PGA Tour, and Constellation Furyk and Friends.

Colin Smith

President, Racing America, RTA Media

Colin is a 1994 graduate of UNC and the current President of Race Team Alliance. Before Race Team Alliance Colin spent time at Raycom Sports, Nascar, and Motorsport Network.

Scott Warfield

VP of Gaming, PGA TOUR

Scott is a graduate from UNC, a member of 2021 Sports Business Journal's 40 under 40, and the current VP of Gaming at the PGA Tour. Before the PGA Tour Scott climbed his way up Nascar eventually becoming a Managing Director of Gaming.

Clint Gwaltney

Sr. Associate Athletic Director, UNC Athletics

Clint is a former UNC football player, a 1992 UNC graduate, and the current Senior Athletic Director for Operations at UNC. Clint spent two years with Andersen Consulting before getting his masters in sports administration from Ohio University. Since then Clint has climbed the ladder at UNC Athletics starting as a ticket office intern and now as a Senior Athletic Director.

A student-run sports consulting group at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.
